brief_text: three balls sit in a row on the floor; the first is rolled into the second, the second rolls into the third, and the third rolls into a cup

usage.text:

verdict.what_happens: Ball1 rolls into ball2, which rolls into ball3. Ball3 rolls into the sideways cup and stops inside it. Ball1 later lightly bumps ball2 again; both settle outside the cup. All three balls are at rest at 6 seconds.

usage.text:
Yes. Ball1 rolls along the floor and hits ball2 at 0.16 s. Ball2 then hits ball3 at 0.33 s. The impacts cause brief, small hops, but ball3 continues forward into the sideways cup, reaches its back wall, and comes to rest inside at about 1.41 s.

Ball1 lightly hits ball2 again at 1.93 s. Both settle outside the cup, and all three balls remain at rest through the end of the 6-second run.
